About us

Faster, safer, smarter delivery for Canada

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Markham, Ontario, Neighbour Express focuses on large-parcel delivery and reverse logistics.

We run sorting centres and transfer warehouses in the Greater Toronto Area and Greater Vancouver, with a network that reaches Canada's major cities. The NB Express API covers quoting, booking, tracking and order history, with built-in billing and settlement for small and medium businesses.
